extraLocators.name: passwordVisibilityToggle
extraLocators.description: eye icon that toggles password visibility; its accessible name states the next action, so this matches it in both the masked and revealed states

extraLocators.name: loginErrorAlert
extraLocators.description: banner shown on the login form after a failed sign-in; its text is the failure message

auth.loginStateDescription: Email and password are entered on the login form as part of each test case. Successful login redirects to the Nexo Desk Dashboard; the 'Remember me for 30 days' checkbox extends the session, so no session token is reused across tests.
